sections.title: Opening Prayer
sections.text: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

sections.title: Daily Petition
sections.prompt: Write a reverent novena petition for day {day} of the novena to {saint_name}. Theme: {theme}.

sections.title: Closing Prayer
sections.text: Lord Jesus Christ, draw our hearts nearer to your Sacred Heart and make us steadfast in prayer. Amen.
